category_scale.1: Some tests pass and some fail

unknown_policy: Any unknown or unsupported applicable test makes its category and strict total null. Bounds describe possible totals, not awarded scores.
critical_policy: A known critical failure makes overall_pass false even when other evidence is unknown. Otherwise all applicable tests must pass for overall_pass true.
arithmetic: 100 * sum(weight * category_score / 2) / sum(applicable weights), using exact rational arithmetic before JSON serialization
atomic_rule_policy: Split mixed prompt requirements into atomic tests, each assigned exactly one category. Retain source criterion IDs and require coverage of every original criterion.
pilot_policy: Rules authored after the pilot are retrospective. They do not make the original generation experiment preregistered or controlled.
evidence_policy: Read frozen native/compiled design artifacts. Never trust generator result.json validation claims as evidence of correctness. Missing or unsupported information stays unknown. No generation scripts are executed.
reproducibility: Identical artifact bytes, rule bytes, and evaluator code produce identical evaluation JSON. Evaluations have content-derived IDs and cannot overwrite different historical results.
